howItWorks.title: How Shopbuddy works
howItWorks.subtitle: A trust-first path from verified Chinese factories to your warehouse in Africa.
howItWorks.stepAccountBody: Sign up in under a minute — buying on Shopbuddy is free, with no subscription.
howItWorks.step1Body: Every manufacturer is document-checked and tier-rated. Look for the verification badge before you buy.
howItWorks.step2Body: Get an all-in estimate in Kenyan shillings — product, freight, duty, and VAT — before you commit.
howItWorks.step3Body: Message factories in English or Swahili; we translate to Mandarin instantly so nothing is lost.
howItWorks.step4Body: Post an RFQ, compare quotes, and order knowing exactly who you are dealing with.
howItWorks.supplierStepRegisterBody: Create a supplier account and build your company profile in minutes.
howItWorks.supplierStepRfqBody: See open requests from wholesale buyers — and get invited to private ones.
howItWorks.supplierStepChatBody: Chat with built-in translation and send quotes that stand out.
howItWorks.supplierStep1Body: Submit your business licence and documents to earn a trust badge buyers recognise.
howItWorks.supplierStep2Body: Add products with MOQ, tiered pricing, photos, and specifications.
howItWorks.supplierStep3Body: Respond to inquiries and RFQs from serious wholesale buyers.

about.title: About Shopbuddy
about.lead: Shopbuddy is a trust-first B2B marketplace that connects African wholesale buyers with verified manufacturers in China.
about.mission: We make cross-border sourcing safe and simple — vetted suppliers, transparent landed-cost pricing, built-in translation, and direct chat — so buyers can order with confidence.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Questions, feedback, or partnership ideas? We're glad to help.
contact.chat: To contact a specific manufacturer, open their product or storefront and tap “Message supplier” to start a chat.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: Shopbuddy connects buyers and suppliers. Buyers browse and message suppliers for free; suppliers pay to list and are vetted before going live. Use the platform lawfully and respect other members.
terms.p2: Shopbuddy is a sourcing and communication platform. Prices, quotes, and purchase agreements are made directly between buyer and supplier — always confirm terms before you pay.
terms.p3: You're responsible for activity on your account. We may suspend accounts that break these terms or harm other members.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Account details (name, email, role), the company and product information you provide, and the messages you send through the platform.
privacy.p2: To run the marketplace — showing listings, enabling buyer–supplier chat with translation, vetting suppliers, and improving the service. We don't sell your personal data.
privacy.p3: You can update your profile or request account deletion at any time by contacting us.

buyerProtection.title: Buyer Protection
buyerProtection.p1: Every supplier is reviewed before going live, with a verification tier (Identity-checked, Verified, or Premium) shown on their profile so you know who you are dealing with.
buyerProtection.p2: Buyers reach suppliers only through in-app chat with built-in translation. Keep negotiations, samples and agreements in the chat so there is a clear record of what was promised.
buyerProtection.p3: Payment and shipping are arranged directly with the supplier, so always confirm terms before paying. If a verified supplier misrepresents themselves, contact us — we investigate and can remove suppliers who breach our standards.

supplierVerification.title: Supplier Verification Process
supplierVerification.p1: New suppliers submit a business or identity document, reviewed by our team before the account can publish products. This confirms a real business is behind the storefront.
supplierVerification.p2: Suppliers who pass document review and keep a complete, accurate profile earn the Verified badge shown across their storefront and product listings.
supplierVerification.p3: Established suppliers with a strong track record can reach Premium status, which surfaces them higher in the catalogue and on the Top Picks rail.

supplierStandards.title: Supplier Standards & Requirements
supplierStandards.p1: Products, prices, MOQs, lead times and certifications must be truthful and kept up to date. Misleading listings can lead to removal.
supplierStandards.p2: Reply to buyer messages and RFQs promptly. Your response rate is visible to buyers and affects how much trust and business you earn.
supplierStandards.p3: Honour the prices and terms you quote, protect buyer information shared in chat, and resolve issues in good faith. Repeated breaches can result in suspension.

disputes.title: Dispute Resolution
disputes.p1: Most issues are resolved fastest directly between buyer and supplier in the in-app chat, where the full conversation and any shared files are on record.
disputes.p2: If you cannot reach a resolution, contact our team with the conversation details. We review the chat record and the supplier's verification status to help mediate.
disputes.p3: Shopbuddy connects buyers and suppliers and can act against members who breach our standards, but payment and delivery are arranged directly between the parties, so we cannot guarantee the outcome of off-platform transactions.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.p1Title: Orders are between buyer and supplier
refunds.p1: Shopbuddy is a sourcing and communication platform. Purchases, payments and shipping are arranged directly with the supplier, so refunds follow the terms you agree with them.
refunds.p2: Before paying, confirm refund, sample and return terms in the chat so both sides have a clear record. Verified suppliers are expected to honour the terms they quote.
refunds.p3: If a supplier will not honour agreed terms, contact us with the chat details. We can investigate and act against suppliers who breach our standards, even though we do not process payments ourselves.
